access.account_hacked_or_locked.title: Account blocked, hacked, or suddenly locked out
access.account_hacked_or_locked.description: Users report accounts being blocked, flagged for unknown logins, or losing access and data without explanation.

access.logged_out.title: Unexpectedly logged out and losing data
access.logged_out.description: Users are logged out after updates or at random, then cannot log back in and sometimes lose playlists, songs, or subscription status.

access.login_failure.title: Unable to sign in to the app
access.login_failure.description: Users cannot log in through email, Google, or Facebook, often seeing errors or blank screens.

access.other.title: Miscellaneous account and app access problems
access.other.description: Users report inability to change account details, offline errors, installation failures, and general app malfunctions.
access.other.suggested_split: Account settings cannot be changed; App fails to install or load

access.password_reset.title: Password reset emails and recovery fail
access.password_reset.description: Users cannot recover forgotten passwords, receive repeated or wrong reset emails, or are stuck after being logged out.

access.signup.title: Cannot create a new account
access.signup.description: Users face errors, loops, and OTP failures when trying to sign up or register a new account.

billing.cancel_or_refund.title: Difficult to cancel subscription or get refund
billing.cancel_or_refund.description: Users find cancellation cumbersome with multiple confirmations and retention pressure, and some report losing downloads or favorites.
billing.cancel_or_refund.suggested_split: Cancellation process is hard; Downloads and songs deleted

billing.other.title: Miscellaneous billing and payment complaints
billing.other.description: Users complain about subscription pressure, billing date changes, free trials, gift cards, and limited payment methods.
billing.other.suggested_split: Payment method and gift card problems; Billing date and free trial issues

billing.plans_family_student.title: Premium plans seen as overpriced or forced
billing.plans_family_student.description: Users feel premium is not worth the cost, that the free tier is degraded, and that features like group sessions require paid plans.

billing.premium_only_controls.title: Basic playback controls locked behind premium
billing.premium_only_controls.description: Free users cannot seek, skip, choose songs, play offline, or avoid ads without paying for Premium.

billing.price.title: Premium price increases seen as greedy
billing.price.description: Users feel the subscription price rose too much or that the app prioritizes making money over value.

billing.subscription_activation.title: Premium purchase fails or premium not activating
billing.subscription_activation.description: Users cannot buy premium because cards are rejected or the option is missing, or they paid but premium did not activate.

billing.unexpected_charges.title: Charged after cancelling or without signing up
billing.unexpected_charges.description: Users report recurring or duplicate charges continuing after cancellation or uninstall, or charges for services they never received.

catalog.lyrics.title: Lyrics fail to load or are missing
catalog.lyrics.description: Users say lyrics do not load, do not appear, or are unavailable for many songs.

catalog.missing_or_removed_content.title: Songs removed or unavailable in catalog
catalog.missing_or_removed_content.description: Users report songs, albums, or regional content that were removed or cannot be found or played.

catalog.other.title: Miscellaneous catalog and stream-count complaints
catalog.other.description: A mix of complaints about content nudity, stream counting fairness, song titles, playlist additions, and unsubscribing.

catalog.podcasts_audiobooks.title: Podcasts missing, hidden, or unavailable
catalog.podcasts_audiobooks.description: Users cannot find or play podcasts, some episodes are hidden, or podcasts are unavailable in their region.

catalog.recommendations.title: Recommended songs and playlists feel irrelevant
catalog.recommendations.description: Users dislike algorithmic recommendations, repeated songs, unwanted podcasts on the home page, and stale daily playlists.

catalog.search.title: Search returns irrelevant or wrong results
catalog.search.description: Users say searches return unrelated songs, fail to show requested tracks, or play a different song than the one chosen.

downloads.download_failure.title: Songs fail to download for offline listening
downloads.download_failure.description: Users cannot download music or podcasts, are asked for premium, or see downloads repeat endlessly.

downloads.downloads_disappear.title: Downloaded music randomly disappears from device
downloads.downloads_disappear.description: Users report previously downloaded songs, albums, and playlists are removed without warning, often requiring re-download.

downloads.offline_mode.title: Downloaded songs won't play offline
downloads.offline_mode.description: Users say downloaded tracks fail to play offline and the app keeps requiring an internet connection or online mode.

downloads.other.title: Downloaded playlists and library content missing or hanging
downloads.other.description: Users report downloaded playlists appear empty or are hard to find, the library hangs, and download options are missing or changed.
downloads.other.suggested_split: Downloaded playlists show empty or cannot be found

downloads.storage.title: Downloads consume excessive storage and misuse SD card
downloads.storage.description: Users say the app takes large amounts of device space and saves offline music to internal storage instead of the chosen SD card.
downloads.storage.suggested_split: Downloads use excessive data and storage

other.boycott_political.title: Users boycott app over political and religious objections
other.boycott_political.description: Users state they will uninstall or avoid the app due to its Swedish origin or perceived disrespect toward Islam and Quran content.

other.general_criticism.title: General negative sentiment without specific complaint
other.general_criticism.description: Users express broad dissatisfaction with the app using short insults and no specific product problem.

other.general_praise.title: Users praise app while noting artist pay or alternatives
other.general_praise.description: Users praise the app overall while wishing artists were paid more, mentioning alternatives, or suggesting minor changes.
other.general_praise.suggested_split: Praise with minor requests or artist pay concerns

other.other.title: Recent update made app worse or frustrating
other.other.description: Users say the latest update degraded the app and removed features they relied on, including missing Spotify Wrapped access.

other.unrelated_or_unintelligible.title: Unrelated, religious, or unintelligible feedback
other.unrelated_or_unintelligible.description: Reviews contain off-topic comments, religious remarks, ads commentary, or unclear text not tied to a product problem.

playback.audio_quality.title: Audio playback has noise, low volume, or silence
playback.audio_quality.description: Users report popping, disgusting noise, missing sound, low volume, or silence at track ends during playback.

playback.background_play.title: Playback stops or misbehaves in background
playback.background_play.description: Users report music or podcasts stopping, crashing, or auto-playing when the app runs in the background or when notifications arrive.

playback.battery_resource_use.title: App drains battery and consumes excess data
playback.battery_resource_use.description: Users say the app uses excessive battery, RAM, or data, and in one case keeps the screen on while paused.

playback.connection_errors.title: App wrongly reports no internet connection
playback.connection_errors.description: Users see false offline or no-internet messages even while connected to a working network.

playback.crashes_or_wont_open.title: App crashes frequently or fails to open
playback.crashes_or_wont_open.description: Users report the app closing unexpectedly, needing restarts, or not opening at all after updates.

playback.device_connectivity.title: Problems connecting to speakers and devices
playback.device_connectivity.description: Users cannot cast or connect playback reliably to smart speakers, Bluetooth devices, watches, or other apps.

playback.lag_or_slow.title: App is slow to load and respond
playback.lag_or_slow.description: Users experience lag, slow loading of songs and playlists, and unresponsive controls.

playback.other.title: Wrong songs play and features fail
playback.other.description: Users report incorrect tracks playing, shuffle replacing ordered playback, sharing errors, looping and skipping failures, and other miscellaneous bugs.
playback.other.suggested_split: Wrong track or playback order errors; sharing and looping feature failures

playback.stops_or_skips.title: Music stops, skips, or plays unexpected tracks
playback.stops_or_skips.description: Users say playback halts mid-song, restarts unexpectedly, or switches to unrelated songs.

support.contact_difficulty.title: Hard to reach customer support
support.contact_difficulty.description: Users cannot find direct support channels, helplines, or email options to resolve account and app problems.

support.no_response.title: Support requests receive no reply
support.no_response.description: Users say their messages and reviews go unanswered by Spotify support for long periods or indefinitely.

support.other.title: Unclear support complaints, harassment after cancel
support.other.description: Users report constant unwanted contact and solicitation for reviews, plus a bad experience with the app that they want followed up on.
support.other.suggested_split: Unwanted messages and review solicitation after cancellation

support.unhelpful_response.title: Support is unhelpful, bot-driven, and unresponsive
support.unhelpful_response.description: Customers say support gives repeated canned replies, pushes bots or refunds, disconnects chats, and fails to resolve their problems.

usability.ads.title: Too many ads interrupting listening
usability.ads.description: Users feel the app shows excessive advertisements, with ads often outnumbering music and disrupting the listening experience.

usability.controls.title: Playback controls limited, broken, or removed
usability.controls.description: Users find skip, rewind, previous-song, loop, like, and autoplay controls missing, restricted, or non-functional.
usability.controls.suggested_split: Skip limits and missing rewind/previous controls

usability.navigation_layout.title: Confusing navigation and cluttered layout
usability.navigation_layout.description: Users find the interface hard to navigate, hard to find features in, and messy, with some saying the new layout is worse.

usability.other.title: Miscellaneous usability and app stability issues
usability.other.description: A mix of complaints including freezing, unwelcome rating prompts, poor dark mode options, confusing search, and unfriendly design.
usability.other.suggested_split: App freezing and crashes; intrusive prompts and popups; search and feature usabi

usability.queue_playlist_management.title: Playlists get unwanted songs and fail to save
usability.queue_playlist_management.description: Users report songs being added to their playlists without consent, random songs playing from playlists, and playlist edits failing or being undeletable.
usability.queue_playlist_management.suggested_split: Unwanted songs added to playlists; playlist editing and deletion bugs

usability.redesign_update.title: Recent update ruined the app experience
usability.redesign_update.description: Users say the latest redesign made the app frustrating or unusable, removed features like history, and hid album covers.

usability.shuffle_autoplay.title: Forced shuffle with repetitive song playback
usability.shuffle_autoplay.description: Users cannot choose to play playlists in order or pick specific songs, and report shuffle repeating the same tracks.

usability.widgets_notifications_lockscre.title: Widget and notification controls broken or unwanted
usability.widgets_notifications_lockscre.description: Users report the widget and notification player failing, showing duplicate or blank info, and being impossible to dismiss, along with unwanted notifications.
